## Summary

<!--
For someone skimming the issue list. One short paragraph in plain language,
with no file paths or unexplained terms. Cover:
- what happens, or what's missing, as a user would see it;
- when you'd notice it, and why it matters;
- the status: blocking, deferred, or waiting on a decision.
If a technical term is needed, explain the idea first and name it after.
-->

<!--
Optional: one small visual, when it shows the problem faster than the
paragraph does. Pick the smallest that makes the point: a before/after
table, a diff of the behavior, a short call or state sequence, or a
Mermaid diagram. Plain text, diff and mermaid code blocks only, since
GitHub renders those. Leave it out when the paragraph is enough.
-->

---

## Details

<!--
For whoever picks this up, often an agent. Record enough to act without
redoing the research. Delete sections that don't apply.
-->

### Behavior

<!--
Expected and actual behavior. Exact steps to reproduce (commands, input,
output), the platform, and the commit or version.
-->

### Cause

<!--
What's known about why, with file paths, symbols and dependency versions.
Mark what was verified and what is a guess.
-->

### Reference behavior

<!--
How tmux, Zellij or Herdr handle the same case, with sources. Omit when it
doesn't apply.
-->

### Options

<!--
Possible fixes and their tradeoffs. Mark the preferred one, if any, and any
choice that needs the maintainer's decision.
-->

### References

<!--
Related changes, specs, requirements, deviation-log entries, commits and
issues.
-->
